name: Image & Video XML Sitemap
author: Harpalsinh Parmar

sections.description:
Image & Video XML Sitemaps adds advanced functionality to Yoast SEO’s sitemap capabilities. This plugin is designed to improve the indexing of your media assets by search engines.

Key Features:

  • Separate Sitemaps for Images and Videos:
    Create individual sitemaps for images and videos to enhance their visibility.

  • Enable or Disable Sitemaps:
    Easily toggle the generation of sitemaps for images and videos via the admin dashboard.

  • Customizable Sitemap Filenames:
    Specify your own file names for the image and video sitemaps.

  • Seamless Yoast SEO Integration:
    Works alongside Yoast SEO to extend its default functionality without conflicts.

Why Use This Plugin?

While Yoast SEO provides a media sitemap, it doesn’t allow separate links for images or videos. Our plugin fills this gap by offering independent sitemaps for each type of media, ensuring better SEO coverage and more targeted search engine indexing.

Advanced Feature:

Even with Yoast SEO’s media sitemap options enabled, this plugin generates independent sitemaps for better control and optimization of your media assets.

Extra Notes:

Please visit Settings → Permalinks in your WordPress dashboard and simply click “Save Changes”. This will flush and refresh the rewrite rules so that the custom sitemap URLs start working properly.

Translations

This plugin is translatable into multiple languages. A .pot file is included in the /languages/ directory.
To create or use translations:
1. Create a .po file for your language using the .pot file.
2. Convert it to a .mo file.
3. Place both files in the /languages/ directory, following the naming convention image-video-xml-sitemap-[locale].po and image-video-xml-sitemap-[locale].mo.

If you’d like to contribute translations, please send your .po and .mo files to [parmarharpalsinh88@gmail.com].

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload:
    Upload the image-video-xml-sitemaps folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins directory.
  2. Activate:
    Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure:
    Navigate to Tools > Image & Video Sitemap for Yoast to enable or disable sitemaps and customize file names.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Yoast SEO?

No. This plugin extends Yoast SEO’s functionality and requires it to be installed and active.

Can I disable only one type of sitemap?

Yes. You can enable or disable the image and video sitemaps independently via the settings page.

How can I customize the sitemap file name?

The settings page allows you to enter custom file names for both image and video sitemaps without adding extension.

Is it compatible with other SEO plugins?

Currently, the plugin is designed to work exclusively with Yoast SEO.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Tested: Verified compatibility with the latest WordPress version.
  • Updated: Checked and confirmed compatibility with the latest Yoast SEO version.
  • Security: Reviewed and ensured the plugin follows current security best practices.
  • Code: Performed general code cleanup and optimization for better performance.

1.0.3

  • Improved: Added dynamic support in media sitemap based on attachment modification date.
  • Fixed: Video sitemap warnings caused by missing or elements.
  • Enhanced: Implemented fallback logic for video title and description using attachment data, site tagline, and site title.
  • Cleanup: General code improvements and better XML escaping for sitemap output.

1.0.2

  • Enhanced our plugin to support a wider range of file types for image and video sitemaps.
  • Added translation support by loading text domain from /languages directory.
  • Improved compatibility with SEO plugins by restricting use of the word “sitemap” in custom filenames.
  • Added admin validation and error notice if filenames contain the reserved word “sitemap”.
  • Ensured all settings error messages are properly translatable.
  • Minor code cleanup and security checks.

1.0.1

  • URLs will correctly trigger your sitemap generator instead of redirecting to the homepage.
  • Performance is improved by avoiding unnecessary flush operations.
  • Query variables are correctly registered.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for separate sitemaps for images and videos.
  • Custom file name functionality for both sitemaps.
  • Compatibility with Yoast SEO.
